name: Nova School of Business and Economics

deadline.intake: Spring intake (semester February to June), direct application window 10 Nov - 4 Dec 2026, 5 pm Lisbon time

requirement.text: High school diploma and/or school examination certificate with transcripts for the last three years; e.g. A-Level AAB with Mathematics A or IB 36 points (Mathematics 6+) for Economics & Management; CV, motivation letter, proof of English and 70 EUR application fee. Conditions valid for 2026/27 only.
